Spring-lever espresso machine
Beans in, a cup out. Press the steps, or wait and the machine runs them by itself.×3
dose0.0 gboiler1.1 barbrew0.0 barin cup0.0 gshot0 smilk4 °C
The big idea: a spring makes the pressure. Pulling the lever loads it; letting go, it presses 36 g of espresso through 18 g of coffee in 27 s, starting at 9 bar and easing to 6.
